_why_hard: The DR drill, manager Slack message, VPN, PagerDuty alert, and identical historical behaviour all look completely legitimate. But the .pem and .env files in the archive are credential material, the archive is unencrypted, the employee has been browsing job sites, and HR flagged sentiment concerns 3 weeks ago. A pure rule-based system classifies this BENIGN. A good analyst holds it as INCONCLUSIVE and checks whether the archive was ever transferred out or accessed again post-drill.
